AcceptTask.description: Make draft task ``task_id`` (one the planner proposed) a real task, to be run.
AcceptTask.title: AcceptTask

AddTask.description: Append ``task`` to the backend's task list.
AddTask.title: AddTask

AgentEntry.description:
An agent role ``name``, shown as ``label``; ``conversational`` if the user can message
it.
AgentEntry.title: AgentEntry

AgentRequest.description:
Agent ``agent_id`` called one of orbit's tools; an ``AgentReply`` with the same
``request_id`` follows.
AgentRequest.title: AgentRequest

AgentStarted.description: Agent ``agent_id`` was started in the ``role`` to work on task ``task_id``.
AgentStarted.title: AgentStarted

BusyChanged.description: Whether ``lane`` has work in progress; new work for that lane is rejected while busy.
BusyChanged.title: BusyChanged

CancelAgent.description: Stop agent ``agent_id``'s work: a review on its own, or the run (or planner turn) it's in.
CancelAgent.title: CancelAgent

CancelTurn.description: Stop the work in ``lane``: the planner's turn, or the task run.
CancelTurn.title: CancelTurn

Catalog.description:
What exists: the ``workspaces`` and their sessions, the ``agents``' roles, the
``triggers`` and the ``lanes``; sent after ``Welcome`` and whenever the sessions change.
Catalog.title: Catalog

ChecksProposed.description:
Agent ``agent_id`` proposed these checks for task ``task_id``, and they all passed on
the current code; the user decides on them with ``DecideProposal``.
ChecksProposed.title: ChecksProposed

CommandAccepted.description: Command ``command_id`` was handled; the events its handling published came before.
CommandAccepted.title: CommandAccepted

CommandEnvelope.description:
A command, ``payload``, with the ``command_id`` its sender chose for it, and the
``session`` it's for: ``None`` means the open session.
CommandEnvelope.title: CommandEnvelope

CommandRefused.description:
Command ``command_id`` was refused, for the reason ``code`` names (one of the refusal
codes, such as :data:`UNKNOWN`), and ``message`` says why; it changed nothing, unless the
code is :data:`INTERNAL`, which means orbit failed partway through handling it, so it may
have changed something.
CommandRefused.title: CommandRefused

ConversationReset.description:
The conversation of the agent ``agent`` ended at the user's ``ResetConversation``; its
next message starts a fresh one.
ConversationReset.title: ConversationReset

DecideProposal.description:
The user's decision on the checks proposed for task ``task_id``; ``feedback`` says what
to change when the ``action`` is ``revise``.
DecideProposal.title: DecideProposal

DeleteSession.description:
Delete the saved session ``session_id``; refused for the open session, or one open in
another orbit. The sessions are listed again after.
DeleteSession.title: DeleteSession

EditTask.description:
Replace task ``task_id`` with ``task`` and make it pending again.

Rejected while that task runs.
EditTask.title: EditTask

ErrorOccurred.description:
An error with no command behind it, of the kind ``code`` names (one of the error codes,
such as :data:`AGENT_FAILED`, or a refusal code where it fits), and ``message`` says what.
ErrorOccurred.title: ErrorOccurred

EventEnvelope.description:
An event, ``payload``, with its place ``seq`` in the backend's stream, counted from 1,
and the ``session`` it belongs to, if any.
EventEnvelope.title: EventEnvelope

FireTrigger.description: Fire the manual trigger named ``trigger`` with ``input`` as its template values.
FireTrigger.title: FireTrigger

Hello.description:
Open the stream as ``client``, speaking ``protocol_version`` of the protocol; it must
come before any other command. ``since`` is the last ``seq`` the client saw, if any; the
open session's events after it are sent again in place of a ``Snapshot`` when they're all it
missed. Answered with ``Welcome``, or refused.
Hello.title: Hello

History.description:
Ask for the events of the session ``session`` logged before ``before_seq``: the latest
``limit`` of them, at most 500, answered with ``HistoryPage``. Refused for a session that
isn't this workspace's.
History.title: History

HistoryPage.description:
The events of the session ``session`` that ``History`` asked for, oldest first, in the
envelopes they were sent in; ``more`` says whether older ones remain, and ``trimmed``
whether older ones were removed from the log.
HistoryPage.title: HistoryPage

ListSessions.description: Ask for the saved sessions, answered with ``SessionsListed``.
ListSessions.title: ListSessions

LogGap.description:
The session's events ``first_seq`` to ``last_seq`` were lost: a write to the store failed
and they reached neither the log nor a fallback file.
LogGap.title: LogGap

MessageSent.description:
The user's message ``text`` to the agent ``agent``, sent as command ``command_id``, was
accepted; the agent's turn on it follows.
MessageSent.title: MessageSent

NewSession.description:
Switch to a new, empty session ``name``d so, or by the time it started if ``name`` is
none; refused as ``OpenSession`` is.
NewSession.title: NewSession

Notice.description: Something worth the user's attention that isn't an error.
Notice.title: Notice

OpenRequest.description: A call ``request_id`` to orbit's ``tool`` that an agent made and orbit hasn't answered.
OpenRequest.title: OpenRequest

OpenSession.description:
Switch to saved session ``session_id``: its tasks, review state, planner conversation and
settings replace the open session's, and nothing runs until asked. Refused while tasks, a
review or the planner run.
OpenSession.title: OpenSession

ProgressNoted.description: A short status note an agent reported while working on task ``task_id``.
ProgressNoted.title: ProgressNoted

ProposalDecided.description:
The user's decision on agent ``agent_id``'s checks proposed for task ``task_id``, sent
as command ``command_id``, was recorded: the ``action``, with the ``feedback`` saying what
to change when it's ``revise``.
ProposalDecided.title: ProposalDecided

ProposedSetup.description: The setup an agent proposed: its ``command``, and the files whose changes rerun it.
ProposedSetup.title: ProposedSetup

ProposedStep.description: A verification step an agent proposed: its ``name`` and ``command``.
ProposedStep.title: ProposedStep

RemoveTask.description: Take task ``task_id`` off the list; rejected while it runs.
RemoveTask.title: RemoveTask

RenameSession.description:
Name the session ``session_id`` ``name``; refused for an empty name, or a session that's
unreadable or open in another orbit. The sessions are listed again after.
RenameSession.title: RenameSession

ResetConversation.description:
End the conversation of the agent ``agent``, so its next message starts a fresh one, and
re-read its role from the project's config. Refused while the agent answers.
ResetConversation.title: ResetConversation

ResumeStorage.description:
Retry the writes to the store that halted the session, and lift the halt once they work,
logging what was parked in the fallback file; refused with ``storage_failed`` while they
still fail. Does nothing while the session isn't halted.
ResumeStorage.title: ResumeStorage

ReviewStatus.description: Whether review is paused, and how many review batches are still open; sent on changes.
ReviewStatus.title: ReviewStatus

RunTasks.description:
Run the task list: every task that hasn't finished, in order, each in a new context.

Tasks added while it runs join in. Rejected while a run is in progress (the planner's
turns don't count); ``CancelTurn`` stops the task in progress and the run.
RunTasks.title: RunTasks

RunningAgent.description:
Agent ``agent_id``, running in the ``role`` on task ``task_id``, with its
``open_requests``, oldest first.
RunningAgent.title: RunningAgent

SendMessage.description: Send ``text`` to the conversational agent ``agent``, which answers in its own lane.
SendMessage.title: SendMessage

SessionSummary.description:
A saved session as the list of sessions shows it: how many of its tasks stand at each
status in ``counts``, and what they cost together in ``usage``. ``current`` marks the
session open here, ``locked`` one open in another orbit, and ``unreadable`` says why a
session can't be opened, if it can't.
SessionSummary.title: SessionSummary

SessionsListed.description:
The saved sessions, the most recently active first; those that can't be read come last.

The ``reason`` says what the listing answers.
SessionsListed.title: SessionsListed

Settings.description: Per-session agent configuration. ``model=None`` means the backend's default.
Settings.title: Settings

SettingsChanged.description: Current settings, sent on connect and after every change.
SettingsChanged.title: SettingsChanged

Snapshot.description:
The open session as it stands, sent after ``Welcome`` and after every switch; its
envelope's ``seq`` is the point it's current to.

It holds the ``session``'s summary, its ``settings`` and ``model_choices``, whether each
lane is ``busy``, its ``tasks``, the verification ``steps`` and the ``steps_title`` they
show under, the ``review`` status (none when reviews are off), the checks ``proposals``
waiting for a decision, the ``agents`` running, the ``transcript``: the session's
last logged events, at most 500, oldest first, in the envelopes they were sent in, and,
while the session is halted because storage failed, ``storage_halt``: why, and how to
resume.
Snapshot.title: Snapshot

StartupChecked.description:
The verification steps ran once on the base commit at startup. Unless they all
``passed``, ``step`` failed with ``output`` (its end), and a draft task to fix it was added.
StartupChecked.title: StartupChecked

StepState.description: One verification step and how it fared after the current task.
StepState.title: StepState

TaskGaveUp.description: The agent working on task ``task_id`` reported it can't do it, and why.
TaskGaveUp.title: TaskGaveUp

TaskMerged.description:
Task ``task_id``'s work was committed as ``commit``, and this came of merging it;
``detail`` says why when it wasn't merged.
TaskMerged.title: TaskMerged

TaskSpec.description:
One queued prompt, run in its own fresh context with its own settings.

``role`` names the kind of agent that takes it, such as ``coder`` or ``reviewer``.
TaskSpec.title: TaskSpec

TaskStarted.description: Task ``task_id`` begins; its turn's events follow.
TaskStarted.title: TaskStarted

TaskState.description:
One entry of the task list. ``id`` stays the same while the list changes around it.

``fixes`` is the id of the task this one was added to fix, if any; it comes right
after that task. ``attempt`` counts the fixes asked of the agent working on it, out
of ``max_attempts``; both are 0 until verification first fails. A task a review
suggested belongs to that review's ``batch``, at review ``round`` (0 otherwise).
``usage`` adds up what every turn run for the task cost. A task that ended badly says why
in ``reason``, one line such as ``Unit tests failed``, with the full text in
``reason_detail``; both are empty otherwise.
TaskState.title: TaskState

TasksChanged.description: The whole task list, sent after every change to it.
TasksChanged.title: TasksChanged

TriggerEntry.description: A trigger ``name``, shown as ``label``; ``manual`` if the user fires it.
TriggerEntry.title: TriggerEntry

TurnFinished.description: The turn ended for ``reason``; ``usage`` says what it cost, when the runner knows.
TurnFinished.title: TurnFinished

UpdateSettings.description: Replace the session settings; they apply from the next turn.
UpdateSettings.title: UpdateSettings

Usage.description:
What turns cost: tokens of each kind, dollars, model round trips and time taken.

Usages add up, so a task's total is the sum of its turns'.
Usage.title: Usage

UsageChanged.description:
The subscription's usage limits, sent after every fetch.

Unless the ``status`` is ``ok``, ``limits`` are the last good ones; ``detail`` says why
usage is unavailable, and ``retry_at`` when a rate-limited fetch is tried again.
UsageChanged.title: UsageChanged

UsageLimit.description:
How much of a subscription usage window, such as ``Session`` or ``Week``, is used, and
when it resets (timezone-aware), if known.
UsageLimit.title: UsageLimit

VerificationChanged.description:
The verification steps and their progress, sent on connect and after every change.

Not sent when no steps are configured. ``title`` names what the steps are checking when
it isn't the current task, such as the startup check; the panel shows it as a heading.
VerificationChanged.title: VerificationChanged

VerificationFinished.description: Step ``step`` (an index into the steps) finished checking task ``task_id``.
VerificationFinished.title: VerificationFinished

VerificationSkipped.description: Task ``task_id`` completed but has nothing to verify, so no step runs.
VerificationSkipped.title: VerificationSkipped

VerificationStarted.description: Step ``step`` (an index into the steps) begins checking task ``task_id``.
VerificationStarted.title: VerificationStarted

Welcome.description:
``Hello`` ``command_id`` was received, in place of its ``CommandAccepted``: the backend,
orbit ``server_version``, publishes its events from here on.
Welcome.title: Welcome

WorkspaceEntry.description:
Workspace ``id``, shown as ``label``, and its ``sessions`` as the list of sessions shows
them.
WorkspaceEntry.title: WorkspaceEntry
